entities.name: Kalinago (Carib) Dominance
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Kalinago (Island Caribs) displaced or absorbed earlier Arawak populations and established warrior communities on both islands. They named Saint Kitts 'Liamuiga' (fertile land) and Nevis 'Oualie' (land of beautiful waters). The Kalinago fiercely resisted European colonization for over a century.
